chunks: The Shaykh, the jurist, Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babuwayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amer narrated to us. He said: al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad al-Basri narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abdullah from Amr ibn Ziyad from Mudrak ibn Abd al-Rahman from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him). He said:

On the Day of Resurrection, Allah, the Mighty and Glorious, will gather the people on one plane. The scales will be brought out, and the blood of the martyrs will be weighed against the ink of the scholars. The ink of the scholars will outweigh the blood of the martyrs.

key_terms.الموازين: The Scales -- the divine instrument of weighing deeds on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.دماء الشهداء: The blood of the martyrs -- the ultimate sacrifice on the battlefield
key_terms.مداد العلماء: The ink of the scholars -- representing knowledge, writing, and scholarly endeavor

ai.seo_question: Does the ink of scholars outweigh the blood of martyrs in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) describes a remarkable scene on the Day of Judgment: when the scales are set up and the blood of martyrs is weighed against the ink of scholars, the scholars' ink will outweigh the martyrs' blood. This hadith elevates the station of knowledge and scholarship above even the ultimate sacrifice of martyrdom, emphasizing the supreme value Islam places on learning, teaching, and the preservation of sacred knowledge.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us. He said: al-Mu`alla b. Muhammad al-Basri narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Abdullah from `Amr b. Ziyad from Mudrak b. `Abd a-Rahman from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will gather the people on one plane. The scales will be brought out, and the blood of the martyrs will be weighed with the pens of the scholars. The pens of the scholars will outweigh the blood of the martyrs.
